title: Prove a sharp asymmetric UT3 tariff gap: 54 versus 53 (no new κ)
body:
## Summary

Scoped algebraic proof with exact finite corroboration. Separate monotone letter-price minima need not compose into one legal UT3(F2) block-call word, even with arbitrary restored dirty workspace.

```text
three central targets; scalar rank cap 3
complete prices: a(d)=5+d^2, b(d)=10+d
separate rank-partition minima: 27+26 = 53
exact full chronological minimum:       54
```

Equality in the separate bound forces three rank-two a calls and two rank-three b calls. The interval between the two b calls and its complement each require a-rank at least three, which excludes that rank list. Four rank-three calls attain 54. This settles the nonproportional-price question left open by #4846 with a sharp counterexample.

Only `research/ut3-asymmetric-monotone-gap/` is added. Produced by Nick Petalas. Credit Arham Tahir #1919 for the block alphabet and rank-volume lemma, Nick Petalas #2129/#4846 for the concave/common-monotone predecessors and open question, and steph4n-gh #1573, Arham Tahir #1589, Hanson Sun #1607, Josie Elliston #1792 and the retained model lineage. Predecessor files and credit lines are unchanged. No predecessor executable was replayed.

[Advance claim](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/1166#discussioncomment-19213517). Scientific base: canonical main `de5ec2e7a6074068452f45b1a191b5c72832df4a`, priority revision 8.

## Evidence

Before, two independent partition optimizers leave simultaneous attainability unresolved. After, the chronological cut excludes their 53-cost equality case and a complete formal endpoint attains the sharp 54-cost bill.

- Registered warning-strict normal and optimized replay, including all 3,840 two-role cut identities, seven rank partitions, ten equality-case letter orders, 36 full endpoint fixtures and 1,296 separately implemented faithful regular-action basis columns.
- Thirty-two deleted-call and three semantic controls reject. A read-only Git-free optimized replay passes; wrong receipt, changed source and missing source copies fail.
- Each registered command was timed directly, at 0.210 seconds normal and 0.208 seconds optimized, below its 120-second limit. These are local check durations, not a performance improvement claim.
- Metadata/source bindings, exact committed bytes/source-history preflight, AST/function-length inspection and whitespace checks pass. The generated receipt binds all five source/metadata files. Publication head: `c33d673cb7e913f0e013c55111558297473d0ce8`.

## Limitations and unrun obligations

The written proof covers the stated formal alphabet for every finite register count. Finite checks corroborate its equations and attaining endpoint. Native implementation, scalar/frame/hosting/routing/precision/tape costs, recursive-child rank interpretation, compiler admission and analytic transfer remain outside scope. No new kappa, physical supplier or complete multiplication theorem is claimed. No Lean, Docker or selected scientific cold replay was run. Independent human and formal proof-kernel review are unclaimed. All registered local checks ran.

## Open next questions

- Characterize compatibility of separate monotone rank minima. Start with exactly two b calls and rank partitions that satisfy the inside/outside cut. The cut alone need not suffice for arbitrary noncommuting words.
- Specify and price one physical UT3 producer/consumer interface, including scalar mixing, frames, preparation, restoration, hosting and precision. Physical realization and recursive rank identification are missing.

## Related open work

- #3905 studies an integer-shear target in a different address group; no shared numerical quantity is compared. The live paginated open-PR corpus contains no other identified open PR on this asymmetric UT3(F2) block-price question. The directly relevant #1919/#2129/#4846 predecessors are merged.

Entry overlap covered 405 open PRs and 5,286 Discussion records, plus distinctive main-branch README and merged-PR searches. Sparse local notes, arbitrary diffs and unpublished work limit coverage. The live open lists and handoff claims were rechecked before committing; no overlapping claim was found.
